mechanism_narrative: Sustained high GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16900 billion) signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2% annually in 60% of observations yet 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.0% in 60% of observations yet 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 94.0) signal severe economic contraction, triggering negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Both UNRATE > 9.0% and INDPRO < 94.0 are met yet 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220.0) during monetary tightening cycles indicates aggressive rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 220.0
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL > 220.0 occur but 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) reflects robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 in 60% of observations yet 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated housing starts (HOUST > 550) indicate strong consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 550 in 60% of cases yet 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: High residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 370,000) during late-cycle expansion phases signals overbuilding and reduced future consumption, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 370,000 in late-cycle yet 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS (rising > 0.1%) and CPIAUCSL (above 220.0) during monetary tightening cycles signal aggressive rate hikes and inflation, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 220.0
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL > 220.0 occur but 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
